## Celebrating Our Achievement: ISTE Appreciation Award Winner 2024 for Maximum Student Enrollment

News Date : 13 Feb 2024News ReportWe are thrilled to announce that our institution has been honored with the prestigious ISTE Appreciation Award for “Maximum Enrollment of Students Among Engineering Colleges” for the calendar year 2022. This recognition is a testament to our commitment to excellence in engineering education and our dedicated efforts to provide an inclusive, supportive, and dynamic learning environment for our students.In 2022, our college embarked on an ambitious journey to enhance our outreach and attract a diverse group of aspiring engineers. Through innovative programs, targeted recruitment efforts, and by offering a curriculum that meets the evolving needs of the industry, we have succeeded in not only increasing our enrollment numbers but also in ensuring that our students receive an education that prepares them for the challenges of the future.This award is not just a milestone for our college but also a moment of pride for our entire community, including faculty, staff, students, and alumni. It reflects our collective hard work, dedication, and passion for making a significant impact in the field of engineering education.We extend our heartfelt gratitude to the Indian Society for Technical Education (ISTE) for recognizing our efforts with this award. It motivates us to continue our pursuit of academic excellence and to further our mission of nurturing the next generation of engineers who are equipped to contribute positively to society.As we celebrate this achievement, we also look forward to building on this success. We are committed to innovating our teaching methods, enhancing our facilities, and providing an educational experience that is not only academically rigorous but also personally enriching for our students.Thank you to everyone who has supported us on this journey. Your faith in our mission fuels our drive to reach new heights. Here’s to continuing our journey of excellence in engineering education and to many more achievements in the future.

We are thrilled to announce that our institution has been honored with the prestigious ISTE Appreciation Award for “Maximum Enrollment of Students Among Engineering Colleges” for the calendar year 2022. This recognition is a testament to our commitment to excellence in engineering education and our dedicated efforts to provide an inclusive, supportive, and dynamic learning environment for our students.
In 2022, our college embarked on an ambitious journey to enhance our outreach and attract a diverse group of aspiring engineers. Through innovative programs, targeted recruitment efforts, and by offering a curriculum that meets the evolving needs of the industry, we have succeeded in not only increasing our enrollment numbers but also in ensuring that our students receive an education that prepares them for the challenges of the future.
This award is not just a milestone for our college but also a moment of pride for our entire community, including faculty, staff, students, and alumni. It reflects our collective hard work, dedication, and passion for making a significant impact in the field of engineering education.
We extend our heartfelt gratitude to the Indian Society for Technical Education (ISTE) for recognizing our efforts with this award. It motivates us to continue our pursuit of academic excellence and to further our mission of nurturing the next generation of engineers who are equipped to contribute positively to society.
As we celebrate this achievement, we also look forward to building on this success. We are committed to innovating our teaching methods, enhancing our facilities, and providing an educational experience that is not only academically rigorous but also personally enriching for our students.
Thank you to everyone who has supported us on this journey. Your faith in our mission fuels our drive to reach new heights. Here’s to continuing our journey of excellence in engineering education and to many more achievements in the future.
